notes.title: Update 0.23.7 is here – Major Performance Boost
notes.content:
Hello Commander,

Today we’ve released version 0.23.7 – bringing some key improvements:

✅ Bugfix: A bug that sneaked in during the Indie Game Fest has been fixed. The AI was occasionally confused – this should now be resolved.
✅ Performance boost: We implemented a major performance update. On some systems, we’re seeing up to double the FPS!
✅ Improved camera: The camera now moves much more fluidly across the battlefield – no more stutters or jerky movements.

We’re still hard at work on the upcoming graphics update. The feedback at the Indie Game Fest was amazing – thank you! We estimate it’ll take one or two more months until it’s ready.

Thanks for playing – see you in the next update!
Your Section Gamma Team

notes.title: Update 0.23.5 & exciting announcements!
notes.content:
Hello, Commander,

Today we’ve released version 0.23.5, fixing a bug that could occasionally display incorrect buttons when starting the tutorial, preventing the game from continuing properly.  

Huge thanks to everyone who reported this issue!

And we’ve got some great news for you:

🎮 Meet us at Indie Game Fest in Cologne!  
On July 11–12, 2025, we’ll be at the Indie Game Fest in Cologne with Section Gamma! Stop by to play the latest version, chat with the developers, and get a sneak peek at what’s coming next.  

We’d love to meet you in person, hear your thoughts, and talk about strategy games and development stories.

✨ Major Graphics Update in the Works  
We’re currently working on a massive graphical update for Section Gamma.
If everything goes as planned, you might even get a first hands-on with the new look at Indie Game Fest. So if you’re around, don’t miss the chance to check it out and share your feedback with us!

See you soon on the battlefield, Commander!

notes.title: Update 0.23.4: New Activity Log & Bug Fixes!
notes.content:
Hello, Commander,

Version 0.23.4 is here with a brand-new feature based on community feedback:

✅ Activity Log:  
From now on, all important activities and battles are clearly listed in a new log.  
You can click on any entry to jump straight to the related action — making it much easier to keep track of what’s happening on the battlefield.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44116730/44cb0e51491de9223106ca8ca2bf0a84ff72f2c0.jpg

✅ Additional Bug Fixes:  
We’ve also addressed a few minor bugs and polished the overall experience.

Thanks again for your feedback — good luck out there, Commander!

notes.title: Patch 0.23.3
notes.content:
Hello, Commander,

We’ve released a small update for Section Gamma addressing a few bugs:

✅ AI bug fixed: In certain situations, AI units inside bunkers were firing on themselves.  
✅ Window positions saved: Moved windows will now stay in place and no longer reset.  
✅ Event management issue fixed: Rare errors in the AI’s event system caused illogical moves — this has been corrected.

Thanks for your feedback — and see you on the battlefield, Commander!

notes.title: Mac Version in Beta Branch & Patch 0.23.2
notes.content:
Hello, Commander,

We've released a new update for Section Gamma, bringing exciting new features and important fixes!

✅ Mac version now available in the Beta branch:  
You can now play Section Gamma on macOS!  
To access it, go to your Steam Library, open the game’s Properties, select the “Betas” tab, and opt into the beta branch. Steam will then download the latest Mac-compatible version.  
Note: Older Intel Macs are not supported. If you encounter any issues, feel free to reach out!

✅ Fix for unit upgrade timing:  
A timing bug caused unit upgrades to not appear immediately – this has been fixed. We've also improved the descriptions of upgraded units.

✅ Improved AI behavior:  
AI players now actively consider defense towers if they are still able to attack – not just during existing conflicts.

✅ Additional tweaks:  
Some icons have been refined, and various smaller bugs have been fixed.

The update is now live – thank you for your feedback and continued support!

See you on the battlefield, Commander!  
Your Section Gamma Team

notes.title: Patch 0.23.1
notes.content:
Hello, Commander,  

A new update for Section Gamma is here! This time, we focused on refining conflict and defense mechanics, fixing bugs, and ensuring consistency.  

Here are the key changes:  

✅ Reworked conflict and defense handling:  

 Fixed inconsistencies – defense behavior is now aligned with existing conflicts.  
 Conquering a bunker now triggers a defensive action.

✅ Improved stage UI:  

 The UI behavior has been revised and is now much more robust against errors.
  
✅ Additional fixes & improvements:  

 Various minor bug fixes and text adjustments.  


The update is now live – thanks for your feedback and support!  

See you on the battlefield, Commander!  
Your Section Gamma Team

notes.title: Hotfix: Building Capture in Mission 2 Fixed
notes.content: In Mission 2, infantry and hackers were unable to capture buildings – this issue has now been fixed. Thank you for reporting the bug and for your feedback!

notes.title: Update is here – Tutorial fixed & Mission 2 for everyone!
notes.content:
Hello, Commander,  

We've just released an update for Section Gamma! The biggest issue was a bug that made the tutorial unplayable. Huge thanks to everyone who reported this – your feedback helped us track it down and fix it quickly!  

As a token of appreciation, we have unlocked Mission 2 for all players – for free!  

Here are the key fixes in this update:  

✅ Fixed an issue in the internal event system that prevented single-player missions from starting properly.  
✅ Fixed the tutorial bug that made it unplayable.  
✅ Various text and translation fixes.  
✅ Adjusted text size on some buttons that didn’t fit properly.  
✅ Fixed an issue where buying large amounts of actions could cause an error message.  
✅ Mission 3: A wrong story sequence triggered when repairing the headquarters.  

The update is now live on Steam – thanks again for your support and valuable feedback!  

See you on the battlefield, Commander!  
Your Section Gamma Team

notes.title: Early Access Starts on 03/14/2025
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44116730/24b8dc9fc518ceee528c717fe141b7bd23d3b1dd.jpg

Hello Commander,
We are making great progress and are heading towards the start of Early Access. 
Keep your fingers crossed that everything goes well and that we can launch on 03/14/2025.
In addition to the tutorial, we are planning to offer the first 3 or 4 missions of the campaign, fully dubbed in English and German.
Today we also released an update for the demo, which you can still play until mid-February. After that we will deactivate the demo in preparation for Early Access. All your game saves from the demo will be preserved.

Please continue to report any bugs you find so that we can fix them.
We are always happy to receive constructive feedback and suggestions for improvement.

notes.title: Development Updates
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44116730/100bcbcfc47278e486ed8726acf6fe5ab11ebbb5.jpg

Dear future Commanders,

We are pleased to announce that Section Gamma is entering its final development phase! Our AI for skirmish matches has made significant progress and now offers challenging matches that will test your tactical skills. Look forward to cooperative battles with friends against or alongside AI opponents.

The storyline of our single-player campaign is finalized, and we are currently working to present you with at least the first 3 missions at the start of Early Access.

Our internal beta testing now covers a wide range of platforms, including Windows, Mac, Steam Deck, as well as smartphones and tablets running Android. We are diligently working on an iOS version. Our goal is to ensure compatibility across all platforms upon release.

We want to express our gratitude for your patience and understanding as we work on the final details of our game. Although we are working on an Early Access title, we are taking the time to ensure that Section Gamma provides the best possible gaming experience.

We have learned ourselves that the last 20 percent before release takes the most time. On one hand, we must meet all requirements from Steam, Google, and Apple. On the other hand, continuous testing uncovers bugs that need fixing, and we implement improvements necessary for smooth gameplay.

Nevertheless, we are confident that we will soon be able to provide an exact release date, but we must remain realistic: a release in the second quarter of 2024 is unfortunately unlikely.

We will keep you updated and look forward to welcoming you soon to the world of Section Gamma!

Your Section Gamma Development Team
